requirements: Existing legitimate account with hub.access and owner consent
Existing private credential available through the established guarded mechanism
Expected denied capabilities confirmed live before sending requests

fixturePolicy: Use only independently authorized actor-owned Staging fixtures; never target operational assets for denied-write tests
verification: Resolve identity and permission from real Portal cookie, never browser-supplied actor fields
Compare fixture rows and object counts before/after denied operations
Do not label skipped/inapplicable cases as PASS
Logout, verify durable revocation, clean only own fixture resources, retain audit events
